title: 新冠感染
problem_statement_md:
给定数组表示30天内的每日新冠感染的人数。
计算输出有多少天超过了30天内**平均**感染数。
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Daily Infections[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

The given array represents the daily number of infections for 30 days.
Find out how many days exceeded the [b]average[/b] number of infections.
[note]Create the condition and output the size of the resulting array.[/note]
hint_md: 创建条件并输出结果数组的大小。

code_templates.solution_code:
import numpy as np

data = np.array([120, 98, 150, 65, 42, 100, 190, 220,
 140, 110, 88, 89, 100, 120, 50, 180, 155, 42, 89, 77, 200, 190, 125, 98,
 77, 40, 39, 59, 30, 67])

mean = np.mean(data)

counter = 0

for i in data:
 if i>mean:
  counter+=1

print(counter)
